answer: The raven is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the signal. By the relic of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
